notes: Correcting the hardcoded interest rate and re-seeding fixed 416 of 503 names. The other 87 were skipped because they carry user edits — and they are AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, JPM, BRK-B, XOM, GOOG, META, V, MA, UNH, WMT and 75 more. The largest and most heavily weighted models in the index kept the fabricated 4% rate. The tail was repaired; the head was not. And since cap-weighted cohort premiums are dominated by exactly those names, the correction reached the part of the ledger that mattered least. The skip itself is right: a bulk job must not destroy hand-tuned analysis. Its failure mode is specific
